property_summary: For any call made by the contract owner to sendTo with a non-zero receiver and any positive uint amount, the reference contract always permits (does not revert) the transfer for amount >= 1; the mutant that changes the require to amount > 1 causes a revert when amount == 1, violating this universal property.
change_summary: Require amount to be strictly greater than 1 instead of > 0, preventing transfers of 1 wei and altering observable transfer outcomes.
